remarks: Welcome to 20 Wildflower, a charming studio townhouse nestled in the heart of Ellicottville, NY. This cozy retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, ideally located across from the slopes at Holiday Valley and just minutes to the HoliMont ski resort. Whether you're seeking year-round outdoor adventure or a tranquil getaway, this property has it all. The open-concept design with Murphy bed maximizes space, featuring a well-appointed living area that can easily accommodate your needs. Enjoy the warm and inviting atmosphere with woodburning fireplace. The efficient and beautifully appointed kitchen is perfect for preparing meals after a day on the slopes. The updated bath has a tub/shower.   After a day of adventure, unwind on the private deck or explore the vibrant village of Ellicottville with its unique shops, dining, and entertainment options. Enjoy the outdoors with nearby nature trails, and take advantage of proximity to both world-class skiing in the winter and hiking, biking, and festivals during the warmer months. This townhouse also offers easy maintenance living, making it a fantastic option for a vacation home or a personal retreat. Don’t miss your opportunity to own a piece of Ellicottville just minutes from the best outdoor recreation the area has to offer.
